pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' orientation; standing tall on hind legs with the neck extended to maximum height.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Low-angle 'Hero' shot to make the neck look even longer and more majestic.
pose_constraints.body_logic: The torso and tail are hidden directly behind the chest. The arms are tucked neatly against the ribs to keep the width under 200px.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The small head with its large eyes should be the top-most point of the vertical silhouette.

character_details.expression: Alert and wide-eyed; a tiny, curious tilt to the head.
character_details.texture: Soft, downy proto-feathers (fuzz) on the body, with smooth, 'vinyl-like' skin on the legs and beak.
character_details.colors: Pale lavender-grey body with creamy white 'racing stripes' down the neck and a soft yellow beak.

environmental_details.ground: Rich, dark soil with a few vibrant green ferns for color pop.
flora: Tall, stylized 'horsetail' plants in the background to reinforce the vertical lines.
environmental_details.lighting: Bright, high-key sunlight; soft rim-lighting on the neck feathers to make them look 'glowy' and soft.
